modelPurpose: Time-uniform simultaneous drop-chance intervals and partial identification of unconditional expected quantity for seven high-priority Midnight rare-gem output mappings; pivot from previously exhausted Dragonflight milling source audit.

formulas.dropChance: successCasts/completedCasts; interval clipped to [0,1] using range=1
formulas.expectedQuantity: sum(outputCount including zero casts)/completedCasts, not multiplied by occurrence P
formulas.noHardOutputCap: E lower bound is simultaneous P lower bound because integer positive output >=1; E upper bound remains unknown/null
formulas.independentlySupportedCap: Conditional E interval from Hoeffding range=B, intersected with [P_lower, B*P_upper] and [0,B]
formulas.guarantee: Union bound across 7 keys, 2 metrics, every completed-cast sample size n>=1. Requires fixed-context iid bounded outputs, full zero-inclusive cast recording, and valid externally evidenced cap if using finite E upper.

eligibility: Backlog keys only, not independent proof of current recipe, rank, unlock, output universe or nominal batch size. A positive integer spell ID in RAW mode is type validation only.
applicability: Each cohort must use one exact fixed character/patch/recipe/input-output-rank profile. Never pool differing profiles; a caller-supplied capEvidenceID is not an independently validated certificate.

outputSemantics.observedMinMax: Sample positive extrema only, not hard game bounds
outputSemantics.outputUniverse: Not certified; single-output analysis cannot establish complete economic conversion value
outputSemantics.grossNetRefunds: Nominal gross = completed casts * supplied nominal input; refunds separately subtracted; aborted requests excluded

evidenceRequest: For each target ore and output rank, collect current-Retail zero-inclusive per-cast outputCount including zero results, exact completed cast count, aborted requests, refund counts, full patch/recipe/skill/spec/gear/unlocks and original source family. Seek independent proof of per-cast output cap before finite E upper bounds.
independentValidatorRequest: Review the alpha-spending union bound and no-cap E partial-identification logic independently; probe malformed RAW context, duplicate cast IDs, refunds, output cap violation and cross-profile pooling. Reserve independent study-family holdout.
blockers: No independent current-Retail zero-inclusive casts for seven target keys
No independently verified per-cast hard output cap, so E upper cannot be identified without extra assumptions
No independent output-universe/recipe eligibility audit; economic recommendations prohibited
No native Node, Lua or in-game verification of new model
